purpose: Evaluate whether the actual-position holding model improves hold/reduce/exit decisions without future information, horizon labels, fabricated inputs or hindsight execution prices.

required_position_input.rule: Position fields come only from user input. Weighted average may be derived from complete remaining lots; missing position fields are never inferred from market data.

required_data.daily_ohlc: legally reusable, provenance-identified TWSE/TPEx daily OHLC that includes the user/episode buy date and every required subsequent trading session
required_data.security_master: historical supported-security classification; ordinary stock model only
required_data.trading_calendar: official Taiwan trading calendar or an equivalently verified trading-session sequence
required_data.corporate_actions: ex-right/ex-dividend, capital reduction, split, new-listing/reference-price discontinuities
required_data.risk_states: attention/disposition/suspension and other model-relevant restrictions valid for each session
required_data.exit_context: only the market/chip/fundamental contexts explicitly used by the frozen production exit formula; every required context must be historically verifiable

holding_age_contract.actual_holding_trading_days: count actual verified OHLC bars from the exact buy date through the latest completed session, inclusive
holding_age_contract.structural_lookback: may be bounded for statistical stability, but must be separately labelled and must never be reported as the actual holding age

position_episode_generation.method: deterministic historical pseudo-positions generated only from information available on or before each entry date
position_episode_generation.entry_dates: sample supported securities across multiple market regimes and entry dates; no cherry-picking by future outcome
position_episode_generation.cost_basis: official entry-session executable-price rule frozen before OOS; cost is not optimized to improve later exit results
position_episode_generation.initial_shares: normalized shares for signal evaluation; monetary P/L may use a fixed notional. Share count must not alter the exit signal.
position_episode_generation.holding_age: count exact historical trading sessions from the episode entry date exactly as production TW-holding-exit-v4 does
position_episode_generation.episode_overlap: no overlapping episode for the same security in the same test stream unless explicitly treated as one continuing position

evaluation.decision_frequency: once per completed official trading session; no intraday information unless a separately licensed production feed exists
evaluation.execution: an exit condition observed at completed-session close may execute no earlier than the next legally tradable session using a frozen deterministic rule based only on information that would then be available
execution_validation: report signals, executable signals, executed exits, execution rate and delayed/non-executed exits
daily-bar tests may not choose the more favorable intraday high or low after seeing the full bar
gap-through stops/targets must use the frozen next-session rule rather than assume fill at the desired threshold
Taiwan tick size, price limits, reference price and known restrictions must be applied
comparators: buy-and-hold through the episode evaluation window

split_and_statistics.split: chronological development period followed by untouched OOS period
split_and_statistics.walk_forward: required when enough licensed history exists
split_and_statistics.confidence_intervals: bootstrap or another documented resampling method on security/episode clusters

required: minimum OOS episode and security counts pass
no material look-ahead or survivorship defect found
production formula hash/version matches tested formula
exit execution logic passes the pre-frozen OOS executability checks
net-of-cost outcome is not materially worse than both frozen baselines on primary risk-adjusted measures
no catastrophic tail-risk deterioration relative to baselines
confidence index calibration passes on untouched OOS data
prohibited: declaring PASS from win rate alone
retuning thresholds on the untouched OOS set
dropping losing securities/episodes after seeing results
using future session high/low to manufacture an executable exit
converting INSUFFICIENT to PASS because the UI needs a recommendation
